## 1. Brand Identity & Operating Model
- **Brand Name:** Aanandham.go (Aanandham Wilderness Glamping)
- **Tagline:** High-Altitude Ridge Camping & Sunrise Jeep Safaris
- **Headquarters & Hub:** Aanandham 4x4 Base Hub, Suryanelli, Munnar, Kerala 685618, India
- **Primary Elevation Zone:** 6,200 FT to 7,900 FT above sea level
- **Official Booking Portal:** https://www.aanandham.in
- **Email:** bookings@aanandham.in
- **24/7 Basecamp Concierge:** +91 90748 58014

---

## 2. Sanctuary & Campsite Directory

### 1. Kolukkumalai Sunrise Ridge Camp
- **Elevation:** 7,900 FT (Highest Organic Tea Estate in the World)
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-kolukkumalai`
- **Accommodations:** Heavy-duty Alpine Weatherproof Dome Tents with insulated ground sheets and thick fleece blankets.
- **Key Highlight:** Private 4x4 Jeep Safari to Jagged Rock Point for peak cloud-bed sunrise (04:30 AM).
- **Meals:** Dinner buffet with live campfire BBQ (Veg & Non-Veg), breakfast, evening tea and hot snacks.
- **Amenities:** Private campfire, 24/7 forest marshal, western washrooms with hot water, charging stations at hub.

### 2. Suryanelli Cloud Bed Glamping
- **Elevation:** 6,200 FT (Overlooking Anayirangal Lake)
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-suryanelli`
- **Accommodations:** Luxury Glamping Swiss Tents with En-Suite Private Western Washrooms and panoramic mountain decks.
- **Key Highlight:** Zero-trek vehicle-accessible luxury glamping, ideal for families and couples seeking complete privacy.
- **Meals:** Kerala traditional buffet dinner, live BBQ grill, high-altitude mountain tea.

### 3. Meesapulimala Alpine Basecamp
- **Elevation:** 7,200 FT (Valley of Rhodotrek)
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-meesapulimala`
- **Accommodations:** Mountain Ridge Tents with licensed Kerala Forest Department guides.
- **Key Highlight:** Guided trek through shola grasslands and mist-covered pine valleys.

### 4. Phantom Head Ridge Camp
- **Elevation:** 6,500 FT
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-phantom`
- **Accommodations:** Cliff-edge dome stays with 360-degree night sky stargazing and campfire circles.

### 5. Vagamon Pine Valley Camp
- **Elevation:** 3,800 FT
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-vagamon`
- **Accommodations:** Pine forest safari tents with private stream bathing and offroad buggy trails.

### 6. Wayanad Chembra Mist Pods
- **Elevation:** 4,200 FT
- **Slug / Route:** `/camps/pkg-wayanad`
- **Accommodations:** Elevated wooden mist pods with private balconies overlooking tea valleys.

## 3. Daily Expedition Itinerary & Timings

| Time | Activity |
| :--- | :--- |
| **01:30 PM – 02:00 PM** | Arrival at Suryanelli 4x4 Basecamp Hub (Secure parking for guest cars) |
| **02:00 PM – 03:00 PM** | Welcome drink, hot mountain tea & Kerala snacks |
| **03:30 PM** | 4x4 Offroad Jeep convoy departure to high-altitude ridge |
| **04:30 PM – 06:30 PM** | Sunset exploration, shola grass walk, photo sessions |
| **07:30 PM – 10:00 PM** | Starlit Campfire, acoustic music & Live BBQ Grill platter |
| **08:30 PM – 09:45 PM** | Traditional Kerala buffet dinner |
| **04:30 AM** | Wake-up call & hot black tea |
| **05:00 AM – 07:00 AM** | 4x4 Sunrise Jeep Safari to Kolukkumalai Cloud Ridge (7,900 FT) |
| **08:30 AM – 10:00 AM** | Breakfast spread at basecamp |
| **11:00 AM** | Convoy return to Suryanelli Hub & Checkout |

---

## 4. Safety & Forest Marshall Protocol
- **24/7 Gated Perimeter:** Enclosed sanctuary fences with night-vision perimeter lighting.
- **Licensed Forest Guides:** Certified mountain marshals trained in wilderness first aid.
- **Sanitary Standards:** Sanitized Western washrooms with geyser-fed hot water.
- **Vehicle Fleet:** Modified 4x4 Mahindra Thar & Major expedition jeeps maintained for offroad terrain.
- **Weather Advisory Policy:** Free date rescheduling if heavy monsoon rains or land advisories affect safe transit.

---

## 5. Pricing, Deposits & Transparent Terms
- **Advance Booking:** 30% advance deposit secures dates and vehicle permits. Remaining balance payable at basecamp on arrival.
- **Payment Methods:** 0% Fee Direct UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Visa/Mastercard/RuPay Credit/Debit Cards, Netbanking via Razorpay.
- **Automated Refund Policy:**
  - **> 7 Days Prior:** 100% Full Refund
  - **48 Hours to 7 Days:** 50% Refund
  - **< 48 Hours:** Non-refundable (Free Reschedule eligible under severe weather)
